label: Checklist and case helper
description: Check a document against your checklist, or turn case notes into a clear summary.

guidance.input: Paste an application and your checklist, or paste case notes and any rules you want it to use.
guidance.output: An application checklist or case summary showing where each point came from, what is missing and what needs clarification.
guidance.limits: It only reads what you supply. It cannot look up missing documents, change business systems or decide whether to approve something. Requirements and proposal review is in preview.
guidance.delegation: It hands your task to a specialist agent (Checklist reviewer or Case notes summarizer), then returns their findings in one reply. It uses both only if you ask for both, and may first ask what you need.
guidance.configuration: Instructions and specialist tools: hosted-agents\review-coordinator-agent\profiles\evidence-review.example.json. Publish a new coordinator version with this profile to change runtime behavior.

prompts.label: Check against a checklist
prompts.text:
Before this project goes for sign-off, check it against our checklist. Make a table showing what's covered, missing or unclear, point to the section each answer comes from, and list the questions we need answered. Don't approve or reject it; I'll decide.

Checklist item 1: Include a project budget.
Checklist item 2: Identify an implementation owner.
Checklist item 3: Provide a delivery schedule.
Section 1: The Facilities team is the implementation owner.
Section 2: Work starts April 1, 2027 and completes June 30, 2027.
Section 3: Work starts April 1, 2027 and completes July 31, 2027.

There's no budget, and nothing says which schedule is current. If the dates disagree, show both instead of picking one.

prompts.label: Summarize case notes
prompts.text:
Summarize these client notes for the team. Show what they say, where they disagree or have gaps, and suggest follow-up questions. Point to the note each fact comes from, and if the notes disagree, show both instead of picking one.

Note 1: Intake completed August 15, 2026; follow-up August 22, 2026.
Note 2: Intake completed August 17, 2026; follow-up August 22, 2026.
Note 3: Proof of address is still outstanding. No supporting document is supplied.

We don't have a written policy for this. What does a person need to check next?

prompts.label: Compare a proposal (preview)
prompts.text:
Compare this vendor proposal with our requirements. Make a table with one row per requirement showing what's described, what's missing and where the documents disagree, and point to the document each answer comes from. Treat brochure claims as claims, not tested features. Don't pick a vendor; tell me what else we need.

Requirement 1: Support CSV export of service-request records.
Requirement 2: Retain audit records for seven years.
Requirement 3: Support single sign-on with documented supported protocols.
Product sheet: The product exports service-request records as CSV and retains audit records for seven years.
Admin guide: The administrator guide says audit records are deleted after thirty days.
Brochure: The brochure says the product is enterprise-ready.

That's all the documentation we have, so don't assume single sign-on is supported.

label: Checklist reviewer
